meta.title: DONNA — the executive assistant that prepares, you approve
meta.description: Email, WhatsApp, calendar, reminders, documents: DONNA prepares the work for you and your teams, and sends nothing without approval.

hero.title: She prepares. You approve.
hero.subtitle: For you and for your company, DONNA works in your email, WhatsApp, calendar and documents. She reads, searches, drafts and schedules, then brings you everything that needs to go out.
hero.note: Access is limited to the tools you connect, and you can revoke it anytime.

demo.label: Demo: DONNA handles a request
demo.request: Reply to Sarah to move the contract review to Thursday.
demo.subject: Re: master agreement review
demo.body: Sarah, Thursday the 9th at 10 am works for the review. I'll send the invite right after.
demo.greeting: Hello. What shall we prepare today?

features.title: Everything she does for you
features.intro: One conversation for your messages, your time and your files. Pick an area.

items.title: Your inbox, without losing the morning
items.example: What did Harvey send me this week?
points: She searches and reads your Gmail
She sums up what matters and who is waiting on you
She drafts the email; it only goes out once you approve

items.title: WhatsApp, in the same conversation
items.example: Tell Rachel I'm confirmed for Thursday.
points: She reads your chats and searches their history
She prepares the message, photo, document or voice note
Nothing is sent without your approval, and sends stay spaced out to protect your number

items.title: Your time, kept for you
items.example: Move my catch-up with Louis to 4 pm and remind me to prepare the file the day before.
points: She shows you your upcoming meetings
She creates, moves or cancels an event once you approve
Her reminders arrive on time, even when the app is closed
No date yet? She brings it up at the right moment

items.title: Your files, quoted word for word
items.example: What are the termination clauses in the Hessington contract?
points: Add your PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files
She searches by meaning as well as by keywords
Every answer shows the excerpt and the source document
When your files aren't enough, she checks the web

items.title: Deliverables, not just answers
items.example: Build me an Excel sheet of overdue invoices from these PDFs.
points: Letters and meeting notes written in Word
Excel workbooks created and analyzed
Data extracted from PDFs, even scanned ones: tables, forms
The file is attached right in the conversation

items.title: She knows you, you stay in charge
items.example: Remember that I never take meetings before 9 am.
points: She remembers your preferences from one conversation to the next
You review, correct or erase what she knows
When a detail is missing, she offers choices instead of guessing
Type, dictate or send a photo: she understands all three

steps.title: Connect your tools
steps.body: Sign in with Google, Microsoft, GitHub or Discord. Gmail and Google Calendar connect in one click.

steps.title: Ask like you would an assistant
steps.body: Type, dictate or attach a file. You see each step while she searches and prepares.

steps.title: Approve what goes out
steps.body: Emails, meetings and WhatsApp messages come to you first. One click to send, one click to cancel.

security.title: Under your control, from first click to last
security.body: An executive assistant handles sensitive information. DONNA is built so that no important action depends on her initiative alone.

items.title: Human approval
items.body: Anything that leaves your account waits for your explicit approval.

items.title: Isolated files
items.body: Conversations and documents stay within your account and your company.

items.title: Cited sources
items.body: She names the documents she uses and says when she doesn't know.

items.title: Two-factor authentication
items.body: Authenticator app and backup codes to protect your account.

items.title: Sessions in your hands
items.body: See your signed-in devices and sign them out remotely.

items.title: Revocable access
items.body: Remove access to Gmail, Google Calendar or any connected account in one click.

items.a: Only the tools you connect, such as Gmail and Google Calendar, WhatsApp if your company enables it, and the documents you share with her. You can remove any access at any time.

items.q: Can she send an email or message without asking me?
items.a: No. Emails, invites and WhatsApp messages stay drafts until you approve them in the app.

items.q: What happens when she gets it wrong?
items.a: Her answers cite the documents she used, so you can check in one click. And when information is missing, she asks you.

items.q: Which files can I share with her?
items.a: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text, images and audio recordings. She can also produce Word, Excel and PDF documents.
Sign in with Google, then ask your first question. No setup is needed to begin.

cta.title: Hand her your next day.
cta.body: Sign in, ask a first question, and see what she prepares for you.

footer.tagline: The executive assistant that prepares, and leaves the decisions to you.

audience.title: For you, and for your whole company
audience.intro: Start on your own, then open DONNA to your team when you're ready.

personal.label: Individuals and freelancers
personal.title: Your personal assistant
points: Your email, calendar and reminders in one place
Your documents and what she remembers about you, kept to your account
No setup needed to begin

business.label: Companies
business.title: The assistant for your whole team
points: A company workspace where everyone keeps their own conversations
Invite colleagues by email
Roles and access assigned by an administrator
A log of sensitive actions

soon.label: Coming soon

panel.title: Nothing goes out without your approval.
panel.body: DONNA prepares your emails, messages and meetings. Every send waits for your go-ahead.
panel.signature: Access limited to the tools you connect, revocable at any time.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Pick up your conversations and what DONNA has prepared.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your backup codes.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.intro: Just for you or for your whole company: you set up your workspace right after.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your account email: you'll get a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, a link valid for 30 minutes has just been sent to it.

reset.title: New password
reset.intro: Choose the new password for your account.
reset.done: Password saved. You can sign in now.
reset.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Request a new one.

welcome.title: Create your workspace
welcome.intro: Your workspace brings together your conversations, documents and connected tools.
welcome.hint: You can invite your team afterwards.

workspaces.title: Choose a workspace
workspaces.intro: Your account has access to several workspaces.

errors.accountInactive: This account is deactivated. Contact your workspace lead.
errors.emailTaken: An account already exists with this email. Sign in instead.
errors.passwordPolicy: The password doesn't meet the rules shown yet.
errors.invalidCode: Incorrect code. Check it and try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
errors.unavailable: The sign-in service isn't responding. Try again in a moment.
errors.generic: The request didn't go through. Try again.
errors.oauth: Signing in with this provider didn't work. Try again, or use your email.
errors.resetInvalid: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
